title: Frequency map
summary: Count every exact, case-sensitive label in a list.

comments.author: Priya K
comments.body: Heads up: the scanner sometimes emits odd labels like __proto__. Please don't special-case anything; every label is just a string.

task: Write frequency_map(items) in Python: count each exact, case-sensitive string and return a dict of string to integer count. Empty input returns {}. Run executes your function against the fixtures in an isolated Python sandbox in this browser.
hints: A dict can hold one counter for each distinct string.
